transcript: This year, I've worked with 12 e-commerce brands doing over $100 million combined. But one thing I've noticed is that 90% of these brands started with a solid product and team of e-commerce experts. But in 2026, everyone has a level playing field with AI. But not every AI is made for e-commerce. So I took a flight, went to LA for Alibaba.com CoCreate, where their president Kuo Zhang announced that Accio Work is now an AI workspace for global e-commerce. They've got 10 expert-trained agents as these AI agents are built on real-world experience from e-commerce experts who partnered with Accio. And when I tested, I can tell from my experience, they are not just AI agents built on generic information. They are designed around real e-commerce scenarios, real challenges, and proven best practices from people who actually work in the industry. So I tested 3 of the 10 agents at their booth, and they blew my mind. Amazon catalog triage expert can find what's impacting your sale, like bad titles, wrong categories, or messed-up variations. Then it also fix all of those problems. Shopify SEO growth expert can rank your store on Google, and writes those blog posts or guides that help those pages rank. Amazon PPC pulse check expert look at your ad campaigns, and tells you what's broken in your ads, such as keywords you are spending money on with no sales. So, no matter what platform you're selling on, any e-commerce seller can use Accio.
